Arena.description: The arena: the whole planet (default) or one real city. Time's clock shrinks the safe radius around `center` linearly from start_radius_km (beat 0) to end_radius_km (the Final Night).

city.description: The city at `center`: on the planet, where the Final Night converges; else the arena city.

end_radius_km.description: Safe radius on the Final Night.

kind.description: planet: regions → cities; city: districts → sites.

name.description: "Earth" on the planet, else the city's name.

radius_km.description: Current safe radius around `center`. Bodies outside take 1-5 damage at each beat's Start.

Army.description: A live army (a cluster raised from a crowd).

chain.description: Its chain of command (general, captains, units, morale, supply, the order as understood; the order's text only for its owner).

dest.description: Where it is headed, or null.

orders.description: Seat view only (your armies): its standing orders.

rogue.description: Its general mutinied: it answers to no demigod.

target.description: What it marches on (a place, or a demigod it hunts).

ChallengeLock.description: Rules 0.8.1: `phase.event.public` when a challenge is accepted (or `round.started.public.challenges[]` for the AI's): both portraits lock in.

a.description: Rules 0.8.1: one duellist at the lock.

health.description: Health at the lock (both are shown: the duel's health bars).

skin.description: Its mannequin's skin. From the name: FNV-1a 32 of the name's UTF-8 bytes with ASCII A-Z lower-cased, mod 5 in this order; unless it holds a thing a god granted (dragonscale) or a thing of gold (gold). Absent from servers before this field: compute it from the name.

also.description: Rules 0.8.2: the duel's scene and panel 0, made with the lock. Handle each entry as its own event.

b.description: Rules 0.8.1: one duellist at the lock.

health.description: Health at the lock (both are shown: the duel's health bars).

skin.description: Its mannequin's skin. From the name: FNV-1a 32 of the name's UTF-8 bytes with ASCII A-Z lower-cased, mod 5 in this order; unless it holds a thing a god granted (dragonscale) or a thing of gold (gold). Absent from servers before this field: compute it from the name.

by_seat.description: The challenger's seat; null for the AI.

deadline_ms.description: Epoch ms: lines after it are refused (null for the AI's challenges).

duel_id.description: duel:s<seq>:<a>:<b> (a player's challenge: its action's seq) or duel:<beat>:<a>:<b> (the AI's)

ends_beat.description: The last beat whose resolve may still carry it (the world keeps beating meanwhile).

focus.description: Centre the camera and spin the globe here.

freeze.description: The world hold the duel requests (supported once the engine has holds).

leap.description: The AI challenger summoned itself next to its rival first (applied at the resolve).

world.description: beating until the engine offers a hold window.

Charges.description: Rules 0.7.0, the 1:5 economy: the player's power charges (public). A MEGA power costs a bolt (and every other player gains bolt_gift bolts, spark_gift sparks); a MINI costs a spark (no gifts). Bolts also pay Time's toll and gods' prices.

Curse.description: Rules 0.9.0: a seal or curse. The public face is the mark on its target; `owner`, `owner_name`, `yours`, `on_you`, `paid_sparks` and `quest` are only for the bearer's and the owner's seats.

counter.description: Always "a mystic quest": every curse has one.

does.description: What it does, in plain words.

god.description: The god whose god-tier variant it is.

kind.description: seal: no resurrection; wither: no healing; silence: wills cost double; bind: can't be summoned; hex: minus its strength on d20s.

on_you.description: It lies on one of your demigods.

strength.description: 1 weak .. 3 god-tier: its counter-quest's length, a hex's bite.

until_beat.description: The last beat it holds; null = until countered.

DayPhase.description: Rules 0.8.0: the phase of the game day.

DuelBlow.description: Rules 0.8.1: `phase.event.public` for each duel line, at once (also in the resolve's challenge.open / challenge.end log).

also.description: Rules 0.8.2 (live event only): the panels this line's stamp made due. Handle each as its own event.

anim.description: Rules 0.8.1: animation cues for the figures (deterministic, from the rules).

auto.description: An automatic blow (an AI counter or a duel nobody typed in).

choreo.description: Rules 0.8.1: the formal model's choreography of one strike (DM_RULEBOOK 21.4).

contacts.description: Every contact: who hits, with which limb, which body part of the other, when (empty when nothing lands).

self_damage.description: A penalty's cost to its author.

tags.description: What the wit saw: verb, combo, body, item, terrain, story, repeat, echo, short, spam, empty, rate_limit.

DuelPanel.description: Rules 0.8.2: `duel.panel`, one comic panel of a duel: the presentation of the blows of one input window (they are decided by the 0.8.1 rules; a panel decides nothing). Sent in `also[]` of the action that made it due, as the event of a `duel_tick`, in `challenge.open` / `challenge.end`, and all of them in `present.duels[].panels`.

at.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

auto.description: An automatic counter of its is staged here.

default.description: It did nothing in the window: the rules default it plays.

line.description: The last line it typed in the window this panel stages (null: none).

line_masked_len.description: That line's length in characters (0: none).

lines.description: Lines it typed in the window.

move_class.description: Its last move's class (strike, heavy, guard, parry, feint, evade, close, retreat, grapple, throw, invoke, command, taunt).

segs.description: Clip segments in order; their `ms` sum to `play_ms`.

on.description: wallrun, wallkick, mantle: the object id.

to.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

also.description: Live event only: further panels made due by the same action.

at.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

auto.description: An automatic counter of its is staged here.

default.description: It did nothing in the window: the rules default it plays.

line.description: The last line it typed in the window this panel stages (null: none).

line_masked_len.description: That line's length in characters (0: none).

lines.description: Lines it typed in the window.

move_class.description: Its last move's class (strike, heavy, guard, parry, feint, evade, close, retreat, grapple, throw, invoke, command, taunt).

segs.description: Clip segments in order; their `ms` sum to `play_ms`.

on.description: wallrun, wallkick, mantle: the object id.

to.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

blows.description: The `n` of each duel.blow it stages.

on.description: `a` / `b` (the fighter hit) or a scene object's id.

input_closes_ms.description: starts_at_ms + play_ms - 700 (the render lead); null: no input (a knockout, the last slot, the outro). Lines stamped up to it feed panel n + 1.

ko.description: Outro only: the side knocked out.

starts_at_ms.description: Server epoch ms: the previous panel's end.

DuelScene.description: Rules 0.8.2: `duel.scene`, the duel's stage dressing in the duel lab's scene shape (in the lock's `also[]`, and in `present.duels[].scene`). `source: rules` is the deterministic fallback; an authored scene will use the same shape.

a_start.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

b_start.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

biome.description: harbour | forest | desert | hills | town | wild

affords.description: The paths that may name it.

at.description: A stage hex [q, r]: x = 1.732 (q + r/2), z = 1.5 r metres.

id.description: Unique in the scene; paths and contacts name it.

kind.description: pillar | wall | crate | table | boulder | rock | tree | log | jar | brazier | altar | chest | bones | cairn

note.description: One line (a cairn's: what the DM remembers here).

offset.description: The part's centre from the object's origin on the floor.

size.description: box [w,h,d]; cylinder, cone [r,h]; the others [r]. Metres.

anim.description: Rules 0.8.1: animation cues for the figures (deterministic, from the rules).

auto.description: An automatic blow (an AI counter or a duel nobody typed in).

choreo.description: Rules 0.8.1: the formal model's choreography of one strike (DM_RULEBOOK 21.4).

contacts.description: Every contact: who hits, with which limb, which body part of the other, when (empty when nothing lands).

self_damage.description: A penalty's cost to its author.

tags.description: What the wit saw: verb, combo, body, item, terrain, story, repeat, echo, short, spam, empty, rate_limit.

Entropy.description: The world's Entropy meter. Every bolt spent anywhere raises it; thresholds make the world wackier (20 weather, 40 physics, 60 riots, 80 godfall); at `max` heat death makes that beat the Final Night.

heat_death.description: The beat heat death struck, or null.

next_at.description: The value of the next threshold (max at the top level).

text.description: What this level does to the world, one line.

ImageObject.description: An image the media server attached (only when the server has images on; see docs/MEDIA.md). Fetch `url` once `status` is `ready` (watch GET /media/index for `hash`); `off` = none will come, show a placeholder.

hash.description: Content key (sha256 hex): cache by it forever.

prompt.description: The full prompt sent to the image model (house style; no engine ids).

url.description: `/media/<hash>.<ext>` once ready, relative to the server's HTTP origin.

Influence.description: One demigod's share of one region (district in a city): crowds there weighted by their allegiance, its Following, its armies, its presence. A region's shares sum to at most 1; shares under 0.005 are omitted.

Item.description: Rules 0.7.0: an item (a manifested thing, or one an older path made).

blessed_by.description: Rules 0.9.0: the god whose blessing it carries (a tier up, and that god's signature).

count.description: Soldiers, vessels, creatures or copies (rounded; f64 range: 100,000,000 is fine).

does.description: Rules 0.9.0: one line saying what it does ("+2 to strikes, +0.5 damage, +1 in duels; Smite: ...").

history.description: Custody: {beat, state, holder?, by?, row?, count?}.

material.description: Rules 0.9.0: what it is made of (the damage type its armour resists; some add to journeys).

rows.description: game.item only: the attempt's ledger rows.

slot.description: Rules 0.9.0: the slot this gear fills (a demigod fights with its best item per slot).

ItemMods.description: Rules 0.9.0: what a piece of gear adds (zeroes are left out). Totals are capped per demigod: +3 on a d20, +1.5 damage, 1.5 guard, 0.4 regen, +3 in duels.

damage.description: Damage added to each strike it lands on another body.

deed.description: d20 modifier on its other deeds (parleys, makings, its own wills).

duel.description: Added to its duel blows' d20 (challenge mode's gear term).

guard.description: Damage turned aside from each hit it takes (never more than half the hit).

regen.description: Health regained each beat, below its maximum.

resist.description: A damage type halved: fire, storm, curse, lightning, cold, water, poison, blade or fall.

strike.description: d20 modifier on its bearer's strikes (attacks and threats).

thorns.description: Damage a demigod takes for striking its bearer.

ItemPower.description: Rules 0.9.0: a once-per-match power (relic tier and up, or Death's blessing).

LonLat.description: [longitude, latitude] in degrees (WGS84). Note the order: longitude first.

Manifestation.description: Rules 0.7.0: one manifestation attempt (made or not).

request.description: Your own only: kind, count, magnitude.

verdict.description: Your own only: outcome, tier, odds {success, twist, partial, backfire, terms}, roll, cost {required, bolts, extra, missing, debt}, god, favor, entropy, reasons, flavor.

Omen.description: A god's ruling as a client sees it (public omens and your own invocations).

god_ref.description: The god's ref (`gd:<n>`; the table is in round.brief.public.gods).

speech.description: What the god said. Never starts with the god's name (render `god` yourself).

Player.description: Rules 0.7.0: one player (a seat, or a built-in AI) and both of its demigods.

bolts.description: The player's purse of lightning bolts (the mega currency; both demigods share it).

Present.description: State schema 8 (exact resume): the present moment, in every public view (so in every match.snapshot) and in `game.present`. See docs/TIME_TRAVEL.md.

events.description: The public events of the instant actions since the last resolve, in arrival order.

items.description: A phase.event.public payload (cast streak, summoning, god_power, challenge.lock, duel.blow) with its `seq`, `received_at_ms` and `beat`.

live.description: This is the match's live state (false: a past state, shown as it was, or a fork before its first Start).

mark.description: The newest instant action the state itself contains, and its clocks.

paused_since_ms.description: The room stands still since then (nobody connected, or restored and not started).

server_time_ms.description: The server's clock when this view was built.

PresentDuel.description: State schema 8: one open duel in full, as it stands now (`present.duels[]`): enough to redraw it and seek to the exact offset.

blows.description: Every blow so far, in order, as it was shown: the state's, then the ones since the last resolve. Each has `at_ms` and `seq` (automatic blows of an unattended duel have none).

clock.description: Its clock when the view was built (frozen at `present.paused_since_ms` while the room stands still).

elapsed_ms.description: Duel time elapsed: the offset to seek to.

opened.description: A resolve has applied its lock.

over.description: Knocked out or past its deadline: the next resolve ends it.

panels.description: Rules 0.8.2: every panel so far, in order.

pauses.description: [from_ms, to_ms] spans its clock stood still.

set.description: The defence each side has set and not used.

started_ms.description: The lock's server stamp (null: an AI's challenge in a state without the beat's clock).

typing.description: Live typing: each side's unsent line as its last `duel.typing` left it (never the characters).

at_ms.description: The server stamp of that message; null: none since this server process started.

len.description: Characters typed and not sent (0: nothing, or the line was sent).

at_ms.description: The server stamp of that message; null: none since this server process started.

len.description: Characters typed and not sent (0: nothing, or the line was sent).

Quest.description: Rules 0.9.0: a mystic quest: a short chain of checkable steps; when all are done its effect applies.

expires_beat.description: The last beat it may be finished on (null: it stays).

goal.description: What finishing it does: {kind: heal, amount} | {kind: boon, bonus, beats} | {kind: temper, item, intent, tier} | {kind: arm, slot, tier, name, god} | {kind: break_curse, curse, curse_kind} | {kind: raise, years}.

god.description: The god whose ruling it is.

helpers.description: Other seats who took it up (a plea for someone else's fallen demigod).

public.description: Everyone sees it (a raising, a seal's counter); else only its seat and the curse's owner.

seat.description: Whose quest it is (their standing demigods do the steps).

text.description: The DM's telling, Rube Goldberg style.

waiting.description: Every step is done but something holds the effect back (a seal on the one to be raised).

QuestStep.description: Rules 0.9.0: one checkable requirement of a mystic quest. `kind` says which, with its own fields: at {place: shrine {of} | settlement {level} | fault | coast | point {at, name}, phase?, offer?}, hold {word}, encounter, shrine, duel, sparks {n}, army {at, name, general}, vigil {phase, times, seen}.

near.description: at: a place that satisfied the step when the quest was given (the nearest shrine or settlement of the kind, the remembered spot): where to send the demigod. Any place of the kind will do. Absent for fault lines and coasts.

offer.description: at: an item whose name carries this word must be in hand there; it is burned.

progress.description: Why it is not done yet, as of the last check (absent when done or never checked).

step.description: Its number in the chain (steps are done in order).

word.description: hold: the word the item's name must carry.

Ref.description: A pointer to any row of the world: dg demigod, ch character, cl cluster, gr group, gd god, pl place, it item, ag agent, lg ledger row, ce cell, mb mob. Stable for the whole match.

SeatHand.description: One hand in the seat view.

demigod.description:
Rules 0.7.0: the demigod this hand is (each hand is one of the player's two demigods; `seat_view.demigods[]`
has it in full).

diorama_prompt.description: The hand's own diorama prompt (identity only, like `portrait_prompt`). The server adds `diorama_image`.

health.description: Rules 0.7.0: that demigod's health (a seat sees its own) and whether it stands.

live.description: False once your demigod is eliminated.

portrait_prompt.description:
The hand's own portrait prompt (it is one of the player's two demigods): identity only, from its name and its
name-keyed visual sheet, the same in every match. The server adds `portrait_image` beside it.

subagents.description: Live subagents and possessions under this hand.

visual.description: The hand's visual sheet: `{sheet_hash, traits: {build, face, outfit, colors, prop, emblem}}`.

Shrine.description: Rules 0.8.0: a shrine to a demigod.

SlowState.description: The open slow-time window as of the last resolve (public: who opened it, never who else is typing). The live window is the Theatre's: `window.opened` / `window.closed` and `match.snapshot.window`.

deadline_ms.description: When it closes at the latest (epoch ms).

opened_beat.description: The first beat that resolved while it was open.

window_id.description: The Theatre's window id (`window.opened.window_id`); submit orders with it.

Stance.description: What it is doing as a whole.

Story.description: Rules 0.8.0: what a demigod's piece carries.

items.description: Items it holds now (pegs). Rules 0.9.0: gear pegs say what they do.

does.description: What it does, in one line.

tales.description: Rules 0.8.0: the newest 8 tales (summonings), oldest first.

SubagentKind.description: What kind of agent a subagent line is: a subagent, a possession (steers a body) or a paladin (a god's champion).

SubagentLine.description: A live subagent, possession or paladin, in every payload that lists one.

beats_left.description: Beats until it expires; null = no budget (possessions last until recalled).

body.description: The person it steers (`ch:<n>`) for possessions and paladins, else null.

line.description: What it said this beat (round.private), else its goal.

name.description: Display name; a possession reads "<person> (steered by <you>)".

parent.description: The agent that spawned it (`ag:<n>`, your hand for subagents and possessions), or null.

Tale.description: Rules 0.8.0: a deed the DM told.

TimeBill.description: Rules 0.7.0: Time's bill for a window the player opened now: debt(t) = min(debt_cap, debt_base + debt_per_second × t) plus one bolt.

instant_order_debt.description: An order without a window (doubled when no bolt).

TimeOfDay.description: Rules 0.8.0: the time of day (`beats_per_day` beats a day).

Visual.description: A character's visual sheet (docs/SHARED_MEDIA_SPEC.md §3.1): picked from the match seed, the character's id and name; the same at every beat and in every replay. Every image of the character carries these traits.

sheet_hash.description: sha256 (hex) of the sheet version, the character's ref and its traits: key art or caches on it.

emblem.description: Their emblem (also on their armies' banners).

WorldMod.description: A persistent world mod (left by a cast's ramifications), applied every beat inside its radius.

stacks.description: 1..5: the same mod again in the same region stacks.

description: `round.committed.public_state` and `match.snapshot.public_state`: the public view after each commit.

caption.description: The latest caption written (narrated one beat late, so usually the beat before `beat`).

caption_beat.description: The beat `caption` describes; null before the first caption.

curses.description: Rules 0.9.0: every curse holding now (public faces).

demigods.description: Every demigod in the match, seats and built-in AI, in id order (dg:0, dg:1, ...). Rules 0.7.0: two per player, the Left hands first (dg:0..n), then the Right (dg:n..2n).

items.description: A demigod as everyone sees it. Positions of live demigods are public; health is not.

cell.description: Alive only: its people-level hex cell (`<face>:people:<q>:<r>`, the client's own indexing; rules 0.7.0).

connected.description: true for an AI-controlled demigod (always there); null for a human one: the game never sees presence, so read room.updated seats[seat].connected.

controller.description: human: a Theatre seat whose player is human plays it (as the game knows: from match start and mid-match takeovers); ai: a Theatre bot seat or the built-in AI. Flips to human when a joiner takes it over. A human who leaves mid-match stays human here until someone takes the seat over: room.updated seats[].is_bot is the live truth.

curses.description: Rules 0.9.0: the curse marks on its piece (public faces: never the owner).

diorama_image.description: Its diorama, the table minifig (images on only; kind diorama).

diorama_prompt.description: An image prompt for its diorama: the demigod as a tiny geometric miniature on a hex diorama tile with its signature prop (subject only: its name and visual sheet, identity only, the same in every match).

health.description: Your own demigods only (seat_view.demigods[]); never a rival's.

items.description: Rules 0.7.0: its public item pieces (manifested, tier relic or up, or deployed).

persona.description: Accounts (docs/ACCOUNTS.md): the character the seat's signed-in player wrote for this demigod, already moderated. Player text: show it as written, never interpret it. Absent for every demigod whose player wrote nothing (guests, bots, the built-in AI).

pronouns.description: The player's pronouns from their settings; absent when unspecified.

place.description: Alive only: the place name it is in.

portrait_prompt.description: An image prompt for its portrait (subject only, with its visual sheet; stable all match).

raised.description: Rules 0.9.0: how often Death raised it this match (absent when never).

region.description: Alive only: the region (planet) or district (city) it is in.

seat.description: The Theatre seat; null for the built-in AI's demigods. A mid-match joiner's new seat takes over a built-in AI demigod, whose seat becomes that seat.

side.description: Rules 0.7.0: which of its player's two hands it is.

sparks.description: Rules 0.7.0: its player's sparks (the mini-power currency; public, like bolts: hoarding is visible).

story.description: Rules 0.8.0: what its piece carries (followers, items, wardrobe, scars).

visual.description: Its visual sheet (stable all match). Always present since the media release; absent in older recordings.

health.description: 0..10; high Entropy wounds gods; at 0 Entropy answers its invocations.

influence.description: Each demigod's share of each region.

omens.description: The last resolved beat's public rulings.

players.description: Rules 0.7.0: the seat list, one entry per player.

players_alive.description: Rules 0.7.0: players with a demigod standing.

quests.description: Rules 0.9.0: the open public quests (raisings, seals' counters).

rules.description: The rules this match runs on.

server.description: The server's current rules version (new matches start on it).

shrines.description: Rules 0.8.0: every shrine on the board.

society.description: The society's public summary (schema 4). Its shape is not frozen yet (the society build is in progress); read defensively.
